page.overview:
Who is Stisk?

Stisk was a character in Five Days at Carthag.

Stisk was a smuggler based in Carthag who led a group that included Valentin, Zoe, Chingo and Maax. She and Zoe met with Valentin when he returned from poisoning Argus Veer and he informed them that calls had been made for their arrest on the Communinet Radio stations of both House Harkonnen and the Imperium, with 20 metre holograms of them displayed in the main concourse. Zoe wondered how they could be looking for them and Stisk insisted that the death of Veer would cause the locals to revolt and allow them to escape. Chingo and Maax then arrived after spreading the work of Veer's death. Stisk then revealed that she had blown their cover by falsely reporting the alcohol in the vault they had hit in Tsimpo as destroyed. Zoe and Valentin were angered that Stisk had made it so they could never return to their homes, as she was willing to sabotage her own people due to her vendetta against the Harkonnens. Stisk replied that the people of Carthag could live if they left the city in time, which was more chance than her sister had gotten.
